WITH category_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN spent > 0 AND amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != 0 
             THEN (spent - amount) / amount 
             ELSE NULL END) AS avg_relative_overspend
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY category
),
overall_avg_line_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count
  FROM category_stats
),
filtered_categories AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.category,
    cs.line_count,
    cs.avg_relative_overspend,
    oalc.avg_line_count
  FROM category_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_line_count oalc
  WHERE cs.line_count > oalc.avg_line_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_overspend,
  AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_count,
  AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_excess_line_count
FROM filtered_categories;

assumptions.assumption: Lines with amount = 0 are excluded from the relative overspend calculation (via amount != 0 check) to prevent division by zero, though they are still counted in line totals.
